title: Add Your Car to CarPlay: iOS 27 Widget Tutorial #shorts
description:
How to add your car to CarPlay with a custom CarPlay dashboard on iOS 27. Pick your car brand, choose a picture and build your own CarPlay widgets in a few taps. Easy step-by-step tutorial for your CarPlay screen.

CarPlay tips for drivers in the USA: Chicago, Dallas, Seattle, Atlanta.

Search Car Widgets: AutoDash on the App Store.

#carplay #ios27 #carwidgets #autodash #carcustomization
